   209→                if retry {

   211→                }
   212→            }
   213→        }
   214→    }

    13→enum OnboardingFlowCoordinatorAction {
    14→    case requestPresentation(animated: Bool)
    15→    case dismiss
    16→    case logout
    17→}
    18→
    19→class OnboardingFlowCoordinator: FlowCoordinatorProtocol {
    20→    private let userSession: UserSessionProtocol
    21→    private let appLockService: AppLockServiceProtocol
    22→    private let analyticsService: AnalyticsService
    23→    private let appSettings: AppSettings
    24→    private let notificationManager: NotificationManagerProtocol
    25→    private let userIndicatorController: UserIndicatorControllerProtocol
    26→    private let windowManager: WindowManagerProtocol
    27→    private var isNewLogin: Bool
    28→    
    29→    private var navigationStackCoordinator: NavigationStackCoordinator!
    30→    
    31→    enum State: StateType {
    32→        case initial
    33→        case identityConfirmation
    34→        case identityConfirmed
    35→        case appLockSetup
    36→        case analyticsPrompt
    37→        case notificationPermissions
    38→        case finished
    39→    }
    40→    
    41→    enum Event: EventType {
    42→        case next
    43→        case nextSkippingIdentityConfirmed
    44→    }
    45→    
    46→    private let stateMachine: StateMachine<State, Event>
    47→    private var cancellables = Set<AnyCancellable>()
    48→    
    49→    // periphery: ignore - used to store the coordinator to avoid deallocation
    50→    private var appLockFlowCoordinator: AppLockSetupFlowCoordinator?
    51→    // periphery: ignore - used to store the coordinator to avoid deallocation
    52→    private var encryptionResetFlowCoordinator: EncryptionResetFlowCoordinator?
    53→    
    54→    private let actionsSubject: PassthroughSubject<OnboardingFlowCoordinatorAction, Never> = .init()
    55→    var actions: AnyPublisher<OnboardingFlowCoordinatorAction, Never> {
    56→        actionsSubject.eraseToAnyPublisher()
    57→    }
    58→    
    59→    private var verificationStateCancellable: AnyCancellable?
    60→    
    61→    init(isNewLogin: Bool,
    62→         appLockService: AppLockServiceProtocol,
    63→         navigationStackCoordinator: NavigationStackCoordinator,
    64→         flowParameters: CommonFlowParameters) {
    65→        self.isNewLogin = isNewLogin
    66→        userSession = flowParameters.userSession
    67→        self.appLockService = appLockService
    68→        analyticsService = flowParameters.analytics
    69→        appSettings = flowParameters.appSettings
    70→        notificationManager = flowParameters.notificationManager
    71→        userIndicatorController = flowParameters.userIndicatorController
    72→        windowManager = flowParameters.windowManager
    73→        
    74→        self.navigationStackCoordinator = navigationStackCoordinator
    75→        
    76→        stateMachine = .init(state: .initial)
    77→        
    78→        configureStateMachine()
    79→        
    80→        // Verification can change as part of the onboarding flow by verifying with
    81→        // another device, using a recovery key or by resetting one's crypto identity.
    82→        // It can also happen that onboarding started before it had a chance to update,
    83→        // usually seen when registering a new account.
    84→        // Handle all those cases here instead of spreading them throughout the code.
    85→        verificationStateCancellable = userSession.sessionSecurityStatePublisher
    86→            .map(\.verificationState)
    87→            .receive(on: DispatchQueue.main)
    88→            .sink { [weak self] value in
    89→                guard let self,
    90→                      value == .verified,
    91→                      stateMachine.state == .identityConfirmation else { return }
    92→                
    93→                appSettings.hasRunIdentityConfirmationOnboarding = true
    94→                stateMachine.tryEvent(.nextSkippingIdentityConfirmed)
    95→            }
    96→    }
    97→    
    98→    var shouldStart: Bool {
    99→        guard stateMachine.state == .initial, !ProcessInfo.isRunningIntegrationTests else {
   100→            return false
   101→        }
   102→        
   103→        return isNewLogin || requiresVerification || requiresAppLockSetup || requiresAnalyticsSetup || requiresNotificationsSetup
   104→    }
   105→    
   106→    func start(animated: Bool) {
   107→        guard shouldStart else {
   108→            fatalError("This flow coordinator shouldn't have been started")
   109→        }
   110→        
   111→        actionsSubject.send(.requestPresentation(animated: !isNewLogin))
   112→
   113→        stateMachine.tryEvent(.next)
   114→    }
   115→    
   116→    func handleAppRoute(_ appRoute: AppRoute, animated: Bool) {
   117→        fatalError()
   118→    }
   119→    
   120→    func clearRoute(animated: Bool) {
   121→        fatalError()
   122→    }
   123→    
   124→    // MARK: - Private
   125→    
   126→    private var requiresVerification: Bool {
   127→        // We want to make sure onboarding finishes but also every time the user becomes unverified (e.g. account reset)
   128→        !appSettings.hasRunIdentityConfirmationOnboarding || userSession.sessionSecurityStatePublisher.value.verificationState == .unverified
   129→    }
   130→    
   131→    private var requiresAppLockSetup: Bool {
   132→        appSettings.appLockIsMandatory && !appLockService.isEnabled
   133→    }
   134→    
   135→    private var requiresAnalyticsSetup: Bool {
   136→        analyticsService.shouldShowAnalyticsPrompt
   137→    }
   138→    
   139→    private var requiresNotificationsSetup: Bool {
   140→        !appSettings.hasRunNotificationPermissionsOnboarding
   141→    }
   142→    
   143→    private func configureStateMachine() {
   144→        stateMachine.addRoute(.init(fromState: .finished, toState: .initial))
   145→        stateMachine.addRouteMapping { [weak self] event, fromState, _ in
   146→            guard let self else {
   147→                return nil
   148→            }
   149→            
   150→            switch (fromState, requiresVerification, requiresAppLockSetup, requiresAnalyticsSetup, requiresNotificationsSetup) {
   151→            case (.initial, true, _, _, _):
   152→                return .identityConfirmation
   153→            case (.initial, false, true, _, _):
   154→                return .appLockSetup
   155→            case (.initial, false, false, true, _):
   156→                return .analyticsPrompt
   157→            case (.initial, false, false, false, true):
   158→                return .notificationPermissions
   159→            case (.initial, false, false, false, false):
   160→                return .finished
   161→                
   162→            case (.identityConfirmation, _, _, _, _):
   163→                if event == .nextSkippingIdentityConfirmed {
   164→                    // Used when the verification state has updated to verified
   165→                    // after starting the onboarding flow
   166→                    switch (requiresAppLockSetup, requiresAnalyticsSetup, requiresNotificationsSetup) {
   167→                    case (true, _, _):
   168→                        return .appLockSetup
   169→                    case (false, true, _):
   170→                        return .analyticsPrompt
   171→                    case (false, false, true):
   172→                        return .notificationPermissions
   173→                    case (false, false, false):
   174→                        return .finished
   175→                    }
   176→                } else {
   177→                    return .identityConfirmed
   178→                }
   179→            case (.identityConfirmed, _, true, _, _):
   180→                return .appLockSetup
   181→            case (.identityConfirmed, _, false, true, _):
   182→                return .analyticsPrompt
   183→            case (.identityConfirmed, _, false, false, true):
   184→                return .notificationPermissions
   185→            case (.identityConfirmed, _, false, false, false):
   186→                return .finished
   187→                
   188→            case (.appLockSetup, _, _, true, _):
   189→                return .analyticsPrompt
   190→            case (.appLockSetup, _, _, false, true):
   191→                return .notificationPermissions
   192→            case (.appLockSetup, _, _, false, false):
   193→                return .finished
   194→                
   195→            case (.analyticsPrompt, _, _, _, true):
   196→                return .notificationPermissions
   197→            case (.analyticsPrompt, _, _, _, false):
   198→                return .finished
   199→                
   200→            case (.notificationPermissions, _, _, _, _):
   201→                return .finished
   202→            
   203→            default:
   204→                return nil
   205→            }
   206→        }
   207→        
   208→        stateMachine.addAnyHandler(.any => .any) { [weak self] context in
   209→            guard let self else { return }
   210→            
   211→            switch (context.fromState, context.event, context.toState) {
   212→            case (_, _, .identityConfirmation):
   213→                presentIdentityConfirmationScreen()
   214→            case (_, _, .identityConfirmed):
   215→                presentIdentityConfirmedScreen()
   216→            case (_, _, .appLockSetup):
   217→                presentAppLockSetupFlow()
   218→            case (_, _, .analyticsPrompt):
   219→                presentAnalyticsPromptScreen()
   220→            case (_, _, .notificationPermissions):
   221→                presentNotificationPermissionsScreen()
   222→            case (_, _, .finished):
   223→                isNewLogin = false
   224→                actionsSubject.send(.dismiss)
   225→                stateMachine.tryState(.initial)
   226→            case (.finished, _, .initial):
   227→                break
   228→            default:
   229→                fatalError("Unknown transition: \(context)")
   230→            }
   231→            
   232→            if let event = context.event {
   233→                MXLog.info("Transitioning from `\(context.fromState)` to `\(context.toState)` with event `\(event)`")
   234→            } else {
   235→                MXLog.info("Transitioning from \(context.fromState)` to `\(context.toState)`")
   236→            }
   237→        }
   238→        
   239→        stateMachine.addErrorHandler { context in
   240→            fatalError("Unexpected transition: \(context)")
   241→        }
   242→    }

   244→    private func presentIdentityConfirmationScreen() {
   245→        let parameters = IdentityConfirmationScreenCoordinatorParameters(userSession: userSession,
   246→                                                                         appSettings: appSettings,
   247→                                                                         userIndicatorController: userIndicatorController)
   248→        
   249→        let coordinator = IdentityConfirmationScreenCoordinator(parameters: parameters)
   250→        coordinator.actionsPublisher.sink { [weak self] action in
   251→            guard let self else { return }
   252→            
   253→            switch action {
   254→            case .otherDevice:
   255→                presentSessionVerificationScreen()
   256→            case .recoveryKey:
   257→                presentRecoveryKeyScreen()
   258→            case .skip:
   259→                appSettings.hasRunIdentityConfirmationOnboarding = true
   260→                stateMachine.tryEvent(.nextSkippingIdentityConfirmed)
   261→            case .reset:
   262→                startEncryptionResetFlow()
   263→            case .logout:
   264→                actionsSubject.send(.logout)
   265→            }
   266→        }
   267→        .store(in: &cancellables)

   269→        presentCoordinator(coordinator)
   270→    }

   272→    private func presentSessionVerificationScreen() {
   273→        guard let sessionVerificationController = userSession.clientProxy.sessionVerificationController else {
   274→            fatalError("The sessionVerificationController should aways be valid at this point")
   275→        }
   276→        
   277→        let parameters = SessionVerificationScreenCoordinatorParameters(sessionVerificationControllerProxy: sessionVerificationController,
   278→                                                                        flow: .deviceInitiator,
   279→                                                                        appSettings: appSettings,
   280→                                                                        mediaProvider: userSession.mediaProvider)
   281→        
   282→        let coordinator = SessionVerificationScreenCoordinator(parameters: parameters)

   284→        coordinator.actions

   287→                case .done:

   289→                }
   290→            }
   291→            .store(in: &cancellables)

   299→                                                                            isModallyPresented: false)

   302→        
   303→        coordinator.actions
   304→            .sink { action in
   305→                switch action {
   306→                case .complete:

    14→class SecureBackupLogoutConfirmationScreenViewModel: SecureBackupLogoutConfirmationScreenViewModelType, SecureBackupLogoutConfirmationScreenViewModelProtocol {
    15→    private let secureBackupController: SecureBackupControllerProtocol
    16→    private let homeserverReachabilityPublisher: CurrentValuePublisher<NetworkMonitorReachability, Never>
    17→    
    18→    private let backupUploadStateSubject: CurrentValueSubject<SecureBackupSteadyState, Never> = .init(.waiting)
    19→    
    20→    // periphery:ignore - auto cancels when reassigned
    21→    @CancellableTask
    22→    private var keyUploadWaitingTask: Task<Void, Never>?
    23→    @CancellableTask
    24→    private var keyUploadStalledTask: Task<Void, Error>?
    25→    
    26→    private var actionsSubject: PassthroughSubject<SecureBackupLogoutConfirmationScreenViewModelAction, Never> = .init()
    27→    var actions: AnyPublisher<SecureBackupLogoutConfirmationScreenViewModelAction, Never> {
    28→        actionsSubject.eraseToAnyPublisher()
    29→    }
    30→
    31→    init(secureBackupController: SecureBackupControllerProtocol, homeserverReachabilityPublisher: CurrentValuePublisher<NetworkMonitorReachability, Never>) {
    32→        self.secureBackupController = secureBackupController
    33→        self.homeserverReachabilityPublisher = homeserverReachabilityPublisher
    34→        
    35→        super.init(initialViewState: .init(mode: .saveRecoveryKey))
    36→        
    37→        backupUploadStateSubject.combineLatest(homeserverReachabilityPublisher)
    38→            .receive(on: DispatchQueue.main)
    39→            .sink { [weak self] backupState, reachability in
    40→                guard let self, state.mode != .saveRecoveryKey else { return }
    41→                updateMode(backupState: backupState, reachability: reachability)
    42→            }
    43→            .store(in: &cancellables)
    44→    }
    45→    
    46→    // MARK: - Public
    47→    
    48→    override func process(viewAction: SecureBackupLogoutConfirmationScreenViewAction) {
    49→        MXLog.info("View model: received view action: \(viewAction)")
    50→        
    51→        switch viewAction {
    52→        case .cancel:
    53→            keyUploadWaitingTask = nil
    54→            actionsSubject.send(.cancel)
    55→        case .settings:
    56→            actionsSubject.send(.settings)
    57→        case .logout:
    58→            attemptLogout()
    59→        }
    60→    }
    61→    
    62→    // MARK: - Private
    63→    
    64→    private func attemptLogout() {
    65→        if case .saveRecoveryKey = state.mode {
    66→            updateMode(backupState: backupUploadStateSubject.value, reachability: homeserverReachabilityPublisher.value)
    67→            
    68→            keyUploadWaitingTask = Task {
    69→                var result = await secureBackupController.waitForKeyBackupUpload(uploadStateSubject: backupUploadStateSubject)
    70→                
    71→                guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
    72→                
    73→                if case .failure = result {
    74→                    // Retry the upload first, conditions might have changed.
    75→                    result = await secureBackupController.waitForKeyBackupUpload(uploadStateSubject: backupUploadStateSubject)
    76→                }
    77→                
    78→                guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
    79→                
    80→                guard case .success = result else {
    81→                    MXLog.error("Aborting logout due to failure waiting for backup upload.")
    82→                    state.bindings.alertInfo = .init(id: .backupUploadFailed)
    83→                    return
    84→                }
    85→                
    86→                actionsSubject.send(.logout)
    87→            }
    88→        } else {
    89→            actionsSubject.send(.logout)
    90→        }
    91→    }
    92→    
    93→    private func updateMode(backupState: SecureBackupSteadyState, reachability: NetworkMonitorReachability) {
    94→        switch (backupState, reachability) {
    95→        case (.waiting, .reachable):
    96→            state.mode = .waitingToStart(hasStalled: false)
    97→            showAsStalledAfterTimeout()
    98→        case (.uploading(let uploadedKeyCount, let totalKeyCount), .reachable):
    99→            state.mode = .backupOngoing(progress: Double(uploadedKeyCount) / Double(totalKeyCount))
   100→        case (.error, .reachable):
   101→            break // Nothing to do here, it will be handled with the result.
   102→        case (.done, .reachable):
   103→            state.mode = .backupOngoing(progress: 1.0)
   104→        case (_, .unreachable):
   105→            state.mode = .offline
   106→        }
   107→    }
   108→    
   109→    /// If we stay in the waiting state for more than 2-seconds we ask the user to check their connection.
   110→    private func showAsStalledAfterTimeout() {
   111→        keyUploadStalledTask = Task { [weak self] in
   112→            try await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(2))
   113→            guard let self, case .waitingToStart(hasStalled: false) = state.mode else { return }
   114→            state.mode = .waitingToStart(hasStalled: true)
   115→        }
   116→    }
   117→}
